newsitem.title: UK: DKB highlights LCI growth potential.
newsitem.headline: DKB highlights LCI growth potential.

text.p: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson underlined the growth potential of London Clubs International Plc on Tuesday, despite a UK government ruling preventing it from acquiring Capital Corporation.
"There is more than enough going on to drive this business forward," the broker said in a research note.
"Although we believe the LCI stock to be fair value, even post the fall today on current fundamentals, impending developments could lead us to upgrade to 'add' (from hold)," the broker said.
Shares in casino operator London Clubs fell 15.5p to 387p, after Trade and Industry Secretary Margaret Beckett ruled out a merger with Capital Corp. Capital shares fell 18.5p to 165.5p.
Dresdner said speculation would now return to UK companies Ladbroke Group Plc and Rank Group Plc or Mirage of the U.S. as future suitors for Capital Corp .
The broker underlined London Clubs overseas growth potential and the benefits of moving two UK licences to better premises over the next 12 months.
